item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"Federal agencies are mandated to impose a specified eligibility and reporting condition through later solicitations, contract awards, and implementing provisions; the definitions and policy language support that dictated procurement outcome.","evidence":"Each Federal agency shall, to the maximum extent practicable, include in contract solicitations as an eligibility criterion for the award of competitive acquisition contracts expected to equal or exceed $100,000"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"Federal agencies must later impose specified certification and filing obligations on covered contractors through procurement administration.","evidence":"Each Federal agency shall require each Federal contractor designated in subsection 3-302 above to"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The segment dictates how EPA and contracting agencies must later administer confidentiality, public disclosure, compliance review, and termination consideration, while leaving the ultimate termination decision to the agency.","evidence":"Information that is not trade secret shall be made available to the public"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"This is mandatory interagency cooperation and information-sharing in support of the Administrator's internal executive functions, without dictating an external legal outcome.","evidence":"Each contracting agency shall cooperate with the Administrator"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Administrator must provide technical assistance upon request, which is an internal implementation and support function rather than a prescribed legal consequence.","evidence":"the Administrator shall provide technical advice and assistance to Federal agencies"},{"segment_id":"6","code":2,"rationale":"Executive officials must incorporate the order's specified procurement requirements into binding acquisition regulations within a fixed period; the disclaimer and effective-date clauses do not independently create substantive private rights.","evidence":"The requirements of this order shall be implemented and incorporated in acquisition regulations"}]}
